description: Source code for the Factory class in the kustomize resource package, responsible for creating and managing Resource objects, including loading from maps, bytes, and generating ConfigMaps and Secrets.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A factory for creating Resource objects, with methods for loading, converting, and filtering resources, including support for ConfigMaps and Secrets.

methods.name: NewFactory
methods.description: Creates a new Factory instance with a specified hasher.

methods.name: Hasher
methods.description: Returns the hasher associated with the Factory.

methods.name: FromMap
methods.description: Creates a Resource from a map.

methods.name: FromMapWithName
methods.description: Creates a Resource with a specified name from a map.

methods.name: FromMapWithNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Creates a Resource with specified namespace and name from a map.

methods.name: FromMapAndOption
methods.description: Creates a Resource from a map with additional generator options.

methods.name: makeOne
methods.description: Constructs a Resource object from a YAML node and generator options.

methods.name: SliceFromPatches
methods.description: Loads and returns a slice of Resources from patch files.

methods.name: FromBytes
methods.description: Unmarshalls bytes into a single Resource.

methods.name: SliceFromBytes
methods.description: Unmarshalls bytes into a slice of Resources.

methods.name: DropLocalNodes
methods.description: Removes local nodes based on annotations unless IncludeLocalConfigs is true.

methods.name: ResourcesFromRNodes
methods.description: Converts RNodes to Resources, filtering local nodes.

methods.name: resourcesFromRNodes
methods.description: Converts RNodes to Resources assuming all are valid.

methods.name: RNodesFromBytes
methods.description: Converts bytes to RNodes, dropping bad nodes and inlining lists.

methods.name: inlineAnyEmbeddedLists
methods.description: Inlines list nodes into individual resources.

methods.name: convertObjectSliceToNodeSlice
methods.description: Converts a slice of objects to RNodes.

methods.name: dropBadNodes
methods.description: Filters out invalid or nil nodes.

methods.name: SliceFromBytesWithNames
methods.description: Unmarshalls bytes into Resources with specified original names.

methods.name: MakeConfigMap
methods.description: Creates a ConfigMap resource.

methods.name: MakeSecret
methods.description: Creates a Secret resource.
